extensionDescription.message: Rewrite, summarize and ask questions about your mail with Claude.

errorHostNotFound.message: The helper service is not installed. Please run "npm run host:install".

errorCliNotFound.message: Claude Code was not found. Please install it and run "npm run host:install" again.

errorNotLoggedIn.message: Claude Code is not logged in. Please start "claude" in a terminal and log in.

errorRateLimited.message: The usage limit has been reached. Please try again later.

errorTimeout.message: The request took too long and was stopped.

composeScopeBody.message: Your own text outside quote and signature (first block)

composeProtected.message: The selection contains a quote or signature and cannot be edited. Please select only your own text.

composeEmpty.message: No text of your own yet. Please write or select some text.

composeStale.message: The text has changed in the meantime, please start again.

composeScopeInsert.message: No text of your own yet. A draft will be inserted above the quote.

composeOriginalFailed.message: The original message could not be read; draft without it.

composeTooLong.message: The text is too long (more than $MAX$ characters). Please select a shorter passage.

composeDraftPlaceholder.message: Write new text, e.g. "Ask for a meeting next week"

composeDraftLabel.message: The text is empty: the instruction writes a new draft.

displaySelectOne.message: Please display exactly one message to read it.

displayOmitted.message: Thread shortened: $COUNT$ older messages left out.

displayShortened.message: Text shortened: parts of the messages were cut to fit the size limit.

displayOmittedShortened.message: Thread shortened: $COUNT$ older messages left out, text also shortened.

displayReplyOpened.message: Reply window opened - click Mail Assistant there.

displayReplyFailed.message: The reply window could not be opened.
